svg.text: Means pooled over seeds (8 eval episodes per seed per mark); band
= 95% bootstrap over seeds (B = 10,000). Thin lines = one seed;
hollow = collapsed seed-ckpt (dev-trained A2″ judged on its
training state; HA-trained A2″ judged on HA, §9 (g)). The HA-
trained A2″ line (3 seeds, trained and evaluated on HA) is the
same in both HA panels: it is the difficulty reference, outside
every family. P and T are stacked panels, not two axes.
